evals.prompt: /groundbreaker init  (empty folder; user answers: invoice app for freelancers, solo, MVP, handles payments)
evals.expected_output: Detects greenfield, asks batched questions with recommended defaults, shows decision table + threat model, asks approval before writing, then writes SPEC, KICKOFF, ARCHITECTURE, DESIGN, CONSTRAINTS, CLAUDE.md, PLAN and runs validate.py clean.
checks: payments => sensitivity=payments and a webhook/idempotency threat in SPEC

evals.prompt: /groundbreaker init --quick  (Next.js repo with existing CLAUDE.md and vitest)
evals.expected_output: Treats detected stack as decided, asks at most 3 questions, merges into existing CLAUDE.md preserving user-written rules, lists defaults as ASSUMPTION lines.
checks: commands in CLAUDE.md exist in package.json

evals.expected_output: Runs through Phase 4 preview and stops. Zero files created or modified.

Maps needs, lists installed covering skills, searches only gaps, vets candidates by reading SKILL.md and scripts, asks before any install, pins commit SHA, produces a routing table of only existing skills.

evals.prompt: /groundbreaker init  (user: 'I just need a 40-line script that renames photos')
evals.expected_output: Refuses to inflate: produces only a short CLAUDE.md and a few-line spec; no ARCHITECTURE/DESIGN/PLAN.
Rejects the unknown enum value, lists allowed types, does not guess silently.

evals.prompt: /groundbreaker refresh  (repo where package.json gained Playwright and a Postgres dependency since init)
evals.expected_output: Reports drift versus .groundbreaker/state.json and docs, proposes specific edits to ARCHITECTURE/CONSTRAINTS, writes nothing without approval.
checks: drift list names Playwright and Postgres
